claims: March 2026 U.S. consumer price index (CPI) data was released on April 10, 2026, at 8:30 A.M. ET.
March 2026 CPI data showed an annual inflation rate of 3.3%.
March 2026 CPI data showed a 0.9% increase for the month.
February 2026 CPI annual inflation rate was 2.4%.
March 2026 core CPI (excluding food and energy) was +2.6% annually.
The next CPI release featuring April 2026 data is scheduled for May 12, 2026.
Stocks rose following the March 2026 CPI report.
Market participants saw improved odds of a Fed rate cut.
US gasoline prices exceeded $4 per gallon.
The Bureau of Labor Statistics maintains the official CPI release schedule.
